semantic_reading.limitations: Viewed full terminal screenshot and embedded pixelated game viewport. Read visible DOOM controls, Resuming DOOM, Working status and model footer. Image shows coexisting UI; no proof of concurrency mechanism, playable runtime, or extension implementation.

semantic_reading.reading_depth: full image viewed with vision
semantic_reading.limitations: Viewed full fish illustration: rounded body, spines, fins and detailed linework. Exact species and mascot identity are not visually established; Exy association is filename-only and marked ambiguous. Viewer background does not establish transparency.

semantic_reading.reading_depth: full image viewed with vision
semantic_reading.limitations: Viewed screenshot with slight automatic resizing; readable startup header, five resource sections, greeting request, read and bash tool blocks, activity status and usage footer. Small footer numbers are not extracted as stable facts; screenshot is historic UI evidence, not current runtime verification.
